  {Omega : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace Omega} [Fintype J]
  {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal m} {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Omega} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu]
  {T : NNReal}
  (eta xi :

  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun omega => energy eta omega - energy xi omega) mu ∧
    ∫ (omega : Omega), |energy eta omega - energy xi omega| ∂mu ≤

        ‖(AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2Algebra.add (eta j) (xi j)).toLp‖ *
          ‖(AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2Algebra.sub (eta j) (xi j)).toLp‖
